change.summary: Initial nbfx registration annotations and layer paths.
Submenus of any surface with @MenuRegistration(path, separatorBefore).
change.description: @MenuRegistration gains path (Menus by default; Menus/<menu> or ContextMenus/<context> for a submenu) and separatorBefore, so a module can declare a submenu of a context menu - the editor's Navigate submenu - the way it declares a submenu of a menu. The menu and view processors now write displayName as a bundle value, so #key references resolve. Under development until the MVP freeze.

change.summary: Drop the Fx prefix from the annotations API.
change.description: The exported annotations and enums drop the Fx prefix: FxActionRegistration to ActionRegistration, FxActionReference(s) to ActionReference(s), FxMenuRegistration(s) to MenuRegistration(s), FxToolbarRegistration(s) to ToolbarRegistration(s), FxViewRegistration to ViewRegistration, FxViewLocation to ViewLocation, FxStatusRegistration to StatusRegistration, FxStatusAlignment to StatusAlignment, FxOptionsRegistration/Sub/Container to the Options names, FxPropertyEditorRegistration to PropertyEditorRegistration, FxProjectTypeRegistration to ProjectTypeRegistration, FxWizardRegistration to WizardRegistration, FxLayer to LayerPaths, and FxViewRegistration.FxPersistenceType to ViewRegistration.PersistenceType. The processors are renamed accordingly (implementation, not API). Source-incompatible; the API is pre-freeze.

head.title: Change History for the NetBeansFX Annotations API

body.p: This document lists changes made to the NetBeansFX Annotations API.
